content:
Overview

Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is a flagship skill training and placement scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development. The scheme provides free skill development training to rural youth in the age group of 15 to 35 years, with a focus on ensuring placement in wage employment. It is implemented through accredited training partners across sectors such as construction, retail, hospitality, and information technology.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Rural youth aged 15 to 35 years
  • Priority for members of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, minorities, and women
  • Family income criteria and school dropout provisions apply as per guidelines

Benefits

  • Free skill development training with a focus on job placement
  • Training stipend and post placement support for eligible candidates
  • Certificates recognised under the national skill framework
  • Placement assistance and counselling after training completion

How to Apply

  1. Register on the DDU-GKY portal or through a local training partner
  2. Attend the counselling and selection process
  3. Complete the residential or non-residential training programme
  4. Get placed through the placement cell and receive post placement support

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Caste and income certificates, if applicable
meta_title: DDU-GKY: Free Skill Training & Jobs for Rural Youth
meta_description: DDU-GKY provides free skill training and placement support to rural youth aged 15-35. Check eligibility, benefits, and how to apply for the scheme.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is the flagship skill development scheme of the Government of India under Skill India Mission. The scheme offers free short-term skill training to youth across the country, along with recognition of prior learning for candidates with existing skills. Training covers more than 250 job roles in sectors such as healthcare, retail, IT, construction, and tourism, and successful candidates receive a government certificate and monetary reward.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Indian citizens aged 15 to 45 years (age varies by job role)
  • School and college dropouts as well as graduates can apply
  • Open to unemployed youth seeking skill certification and employment

Benefits

  • Free skill training in industry relevant job roles
  • Government certification recognised under the skill framework
  • Monetary reward on successful completion of training and assessment
  • Placement and entrepreneurship support through training centres

How to Apply

  1. Visit the Skill India portal or the nearest PMKVY training centre
  2. Choose a job role and complete the registration process
  3. Attend the training and the final assessment
  4. Receive the certificate and reward after passing the assessment

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Passport size photograph
meta_title: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana: Free Skill Training with Certificate
meta_description: PMKVY offers free skill training, certification, and monetary rewards to Indian youth. Check eligibility, job roles, and how to enrol in the scheme.

content:
Overview

The National Career Service (NCS) portal is a government platform that connects job seekers with employers and career counselling services across India. Launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, the portal provides free registration for job seekers, vacancy listings from employers, skill development information, and career guidance. It is a one stop digital solution for employment related services.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all Indian job seekers above the age of 14 years
  • Employers, educational institutions, and training providers can also register
  • No fee is charged for registration or services

Benefits

  • Free job seeker registration and access to lakhs of vacancies
  • Career counselling through dedicated centres and online tools
  • Job alerts matched to the candidate's profile
  • Information on skill training, apprenticeships, and government schemes

How to Apply

  1. Visit the National Career Service portal and create an account
  2. Complete the profile with education, skills, and experience details
  3. Search for jobs and apply online
  4. Receive job alerts and access career guidance resources

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card or any government-issued identity proof
  • Educational and experience certificates
  • Resume for job applications
meta_title: National Career Service Portal: Free Job Search & Counselling
meta_description: NCS portal offers free job search, vacancy alerts, and career counselling for Indian job seekers. Learn how to register and find jobs online.

content:
Overview

PM Vishwakarma is a central sector scheme launched in 2023 to support traditional artisans and craftspeople, known as Vishwakarma, across 18 traditional trades. The scheme provides recognition, skill training, toolkits, and credit support at concessional rates to enable artisans to improve the quality and marketability of their products. It covers trades such as carpentry, blacksmith, pottery, tailoring, and barber services.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Artisans and craftspeople engaged in any of the 18 notified traditional trades
  • Age between 18 and 40 years at the time of enrolment
  • Should be self-employed and not availing benefits under similar credit schemes
  • Family members can also be covered as per the scheme guidelines

Benefits

  • Skill upgradation training with a daily stipend
  • Toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000 provided in instalments
  • Collateral free loans up to Rs 3 lakh at a concessional interest rate of 5 percent
  • Assistance for digital transactions and branding of products

How to Apply

  1. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre or the official PM Vishwakarma portal
  2. Complete the biometric enrolment and provide trade details
  3. Undergo skill training and receive the toolkit
  4. Avail the loan through empanelled banks after certification

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Age proof
  • Proof of engagement in the notified trade
meta_title: PM Vishwakarma: Loans & Training for Artisans and Craftsmen
meta_description: PM Vishwakarma supports traditional artisans with free training, toolkit of Rs 15,000, and loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 5% interest. Check eligibility.

content:
Overview

Atmanirbhar Bharat Rozgar Yojana (ABRY) was launched in 2020 to incentivise the creation of new employment during the post-pandemic recovery period. The scheme provided employee provident fund contributions by the government for new employees joining establishments affected by COVID-19. It aimed to reduce the financial burden on employers while creating social security benefits for workers newly entering the organised workforce.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Establishments registered with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
  • New employees joining on or after the scheme start date and earning up to Rs 15,000 per month
  • Employees should not have been working in an EPFO covered establishment before

Benefits

  • Government pays both the employee and employer EPF contributions for eligible new employees for a specified period
  • Reduced hiring cost for employers, encouraging new recruitment
  • Social security coverage for new workers from day one

How to Apply

  1. Employers claim the benefit through the EPFO portal
  2. Register the new employee on the portal with correct UAN details
  3. The subsidy is credited to the EPF account as per the claim cycle

Required Documents

  • Employer registration details with EPFO
  • Employee details including Aadhaar and bank account
  • Employee's prior employment declaration
meta_title: Atmanirbhar Bharat Rozgar Yojana: EPF Support for New Jobs
meta_description: ABRY incentivises new employment by paying EPF contributions for eligible new employees. Check eligibility criteria and how employers can claim.

content:
Overview

Garib Kalyan Rozgar Yojana (GKRY) was launched as a 125 day programme to provide employment opportunities to migrant workers and rural citizens returning to their villages during the pandemic. The scheme generated work through public works such as rural roads, water conservation, and community assets, with wages paid under the Mahatma Gandhi NREGA framework. It was implemented as an addition to existing rural employment programmes.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Returning migrant workers and rural citizens in eligible districts
  • Beneficiaries register through the local panchayat or employment office
  • Priority for persons who lost work due to the pandemic

Benefits

  • Guaranteed wage employment for up to 125 days
  • Wages at par with the NREGA wage rates
  • Creation of rural infrastructure benefiting the community
  • On demand work under the Mahatma Gandhi NREGA framework

How to Apply

  1. Register with the village panchayat or the block development office
  2. Enrol for work as per the demand and allocation process
  3. Receive wages directly in the bank account after completing the work days

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Job card under the NREGA where applicable
meta_title: Garib Kalyan Rozgar Yojana: 125 Days Wage Employment
meta_description: Garib Kalyan Rozgar Yojana provided 125 days of wage employment to returning migrants and rural citizens. Check eligibility and how it worked.

content:
Overview

The National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) promotes apprenticeship training in India by sharing the cost of stipends paid to apprentices. Under the scheme, the government reimburses a part of the stipend paid by establishments to apprentices, encouraging industries to hire and train young people. Apprentices gain practical, on the job skills while earning a stipend, improving their employability.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Youth aged 14 to 35 years with the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the trade
  • ITI, diploma, and graduate apprentices are covered
  • Establishments across all sectors can engage apprentices under the scheme

Benefits

  • Government reimbursement of a portion of the apprentice stipend to establishments
  • Practical training and industry exposure for apprentices
  • Monthly stipend paid by the establishment during the training period
  • Certification of apprenticeship improving future job prospects

How to Apply

  1. Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal
  2. Search for apprenticeship opportunities in your trade and location
  3. Apply to establishments and complete the selection process
  4. Join the apprenticeship and complete the training duration

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Bank account details for stipend
meta_title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme: Stipend & Training
meta_description: NAPS supports apprenticeship training with stipend reimbursement to establishments. Learn eligibility, benefits, and how to apply as an apprentice.

content:
Overview

e-Shram is a national database of unorganised workers created by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. The portal registers workers such as agricultural labourers, construction workers, street vendors, and gig workers, and issues a Universal Account Number (UAN) to each registered worker. The database helps extend social security benefits and government schemes to the vast unorganised workforce of India.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Workers in the unorganised sector aged between 16 and 59 years
  • Should not be a member of EPFO or ESIC
  • Should not be an income tax payer

Benefits

  • Free registration with a Universal Account Number (UAN) for every worker
  • Identity and entitlement card for availing future social security benefits
  • Accidental insurance cover as announced under the scheme
  • Better access to government schemes designed for unorganised workers

How to Apply

  1. Visit the e-Shram portal or the nearest Common Service Centre
  2. Provide Aadhaar and bank account details for verification
  3. Complete the registration and receive the e-Shram card with UAN

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details
  • Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
meta_title: e-Shram Portal: Register Unorganised Workers for Benefits
meta_description: e-Shram registers unorganised sector workers and provides a Universal Account Number for social security access. Learn how to register online.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) is a voluntary pension scheme for unorganised workers in India. Workers in the age group of 18 to 40 years can enrol by contributing a monthly amount ranging from Rs 55 to Rs 200, with the central government contributing an equal amount to the pension fund. On reaching 60 years of age, the worker receives a monthly pension of Rs 3,000, along with family pension for the spouse.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 years, including street vendors, rickshaw pullers, and agricultural workers
  • Monthly income of Rs 15,000 or below
  • Should not be covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS, and should not be an income tax payer

Benefits

  • Monthly pension of Rs 3,000 after the age of 60
  • Equal government contribution to the pension account
  • Family pension of 50 percent to the spouse after the member's death
  • Low monthly contribution starting from Rs 55

How to Apply

  1. Visit a Common Service Centre or the PM-SYM web portal
  2. Provide Aadhaar and bank account details
  3. Complete the self declaration and start monthly contributions

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
meta_title: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan: Rs 3,000 Pension for Unorganised Workers
meta_description: PM-SYM provides Rs 3,000 monthly pension to unorganised workers after age 60 with equal government contribution. Check eligibility and how to enrol.

content:
Overview

Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) is the digital platform of the Skill India mission that brings together skill training, job opportunities, and entrepreneurship support in one place. The platform provides access to free courses, certification, career counselling, and job listings from partner industries. It uses emerging technologies to personalise learning and connect candidates with relevant opportunities.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all Indian citizens seeking skill development and employment
  • Students, job seekers, and working professionals can register
  • No fee is charged for basic registration and courses

Benefits

  • Free access to short term skill courses and certification
  • Job and apprenticeship opportunities from partner industries
  • Career guidance and skill gap assessment tools
  • Recognition of prior learning and reskilling programmes

How to Apply

  1. Visit the Skill India Digital Hub portal
  2. Create an account with basic details
  3. Browse courses, complete the learning modules, and earn certificates
  4. Apply for jobs and apprenticeships through the platform

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card for verification
  • Educational qualification details
meta_title: Skill India Digital Hub: Free Courses, Certificates & Jobs
meta_description: Skill India Digital Hub offers free skill courses, certification, job listings, and career counselling in one platform. Learn how to register.

content:
Overview

The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit linked subsidy scheme for generating self employment opportunities in rural and urban areas. Implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), the scheme provides financial assistance for setting up micro enterprises in manufacturing, service, and trading sectors. New entrepreneurs receive margin money subsidy on the project cost, with the balance financed by banks.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Individuals above 18 years of age with at least Class 8 education (relaxed for certain categories)
  • Self help groups, cooperatives, and charitable trusts are eligible
  • Existing units and units that have availed similar subsidies are not eligible
  • Project cost up to Rs 25 lakh in manufacturing and Rs 10 lakh in service sectors

Benefits

  • Margin money subsidy of 15 to 35 percent of the project cost depending on category and location
  • Bank loan for the remaining project cost at normal rates
  • Support for setting up new micro enterprises in rural and urban areas
  • Employment generation for the entrepreneur and additional workers

How to Apply

  1. Prepare a project report for the proposed enterprise
  2. Apply online on the PMEGP portal with the required documents
  3. Attend the district level task force committee meeting for approval
  4. Receive the sanction letter and approach the bank for the loan

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Project report and cost estimates
  • Caste and income certificates, if applicable
meta_title: PMEGP: Subsidy & Loans for New Micro Enterprises
meta_description: PMEGP provides margin money subsidy and bank loans for new micro enterprises in manufacturing and services. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) was a scheme that incentivised formal employment by reimbursing the employer's contribution to the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) for new employees. Implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, the scheme covered establishments registered with EPFO and aimed to promote job creation in the formal sector. It reduced the cost of hiring for employers while extending social security benefits to workers.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Establishments registered with EPFO employing eligible new workers
  • Employees earning up to Rs 15,000 per month
  • New employees joining the formal workforce for the first time

Benefits

  • Government pays the employer's EPF contribution for eligible new employees for a specified period
  • Lower cost of formal hiring for establishments
  • Social security and provident fund coverage for new employees

How to Apply

  1. Employers register the new employee on the EPFO portal
  2. Claim the reimbursement as per the scheme's claim process
  3. The amount is credited to the EPF account of the employee

Required Documents

  • Employer and establishment registration details
  • Employee UAN and Aadhaar details
meta_title: PM Rozgar Protsahan Yojana: EPF Support for New Employees
meta_description: PMRPY reimbursed employers' EPF contribution for new employees to promote formal employment. Check eligibility and how the scheme worked.

content:
Overview

The Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM) is a flagship scheme that reduces poverty and vulnerability of urban poor households by enabling access to self employment and skilled wage employment. The scheme supports urban street vendors, women self help groups, and youth through skill training, credit linkage, and enterprise development. It also provides shelter and basic services for urban homeless persons.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Urban poor households identified through a social registry
  • Women, scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, and minorities are prioritised
  • Street vendors covered under the street vendor component and youth for skill training

Benefits

  • Formation and credit linkage of women self help groups in urban areas
  • Skill training and placement support for urban youth
  • Subsidy and bank loans for micro enterprises under the scheme
  • Support for street vendors and shelters for the urban homeless

How to Apply

  1. Contact the city urban livelihood mission or the municipal corporation
  2. Enrol in a self help group or apply for skill training
  3. Submit the loan proposal through the mission for enterprise support

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Address proof in the urban area
  • Category certificates, if applicable
meta_title: DAY-NULM: Self Employment & Skills for Urban Poor
meta_description: DAY-NULM supports urban poor through SHGs, skill training, micro enterprise loans, and street vendor support. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) was a self employment programme of the Ministry of Rural Development for rural poor families. The scheme organised beneficiaries into self help groups and provided training, credit, and subsidy for income generating activities such as agriculture, animal husbandry, and village industries. SGSY was later restructured into the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM), now known as Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Rural families living below the poverty line were eligible
  • Priority for scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, women, and disabled persons
  • Beneficiaries were organised into self help groups

Benefits

  • Subsidy support for income generating activities
  • Credit linkage through banks for micro enterprises
  • Skill training for members of self help groups
  • Support for group based livelihood activities

How to Apply

  1. Under the successor DAY-NRLM, join a self help group in your village
  2. Participate in group formation and capacity building activities
  3. Access credit and subsidy through the block level mission unit

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Below poverty line identification details
meta_title: SGSY: Rural Self Employment Through Self Help Groups
meta_description: SGSY promoted self employment for rural poor through self help groups, training, and credit. Now restructured as DAY-NRLM. Know how it worked.

content:
Overview

Rozgar Mela is a nationwide recruitment drive organised by the Government of India for filling vacancies in various central government departments and ministries. Through these melas, appointment letters are handed over to selected candidates for posts such as clerks, assistants, constables, and junior engineers. The initiative accelerates recruitment processing and provides a single platform for candidates to receive their appointments.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates selected through the respective recruitment processes of participating departments
  • Selection is based on examinations or interviews conducted by the departments
  • Eligibility follows the recruitment notification of each department

Benefits

  • Transparent and accelerated recruitment to central government posts
  • Appointment letters distributed at organised mela events
  • Direct entry into central government service with regular pay and benefits

How to Apply

  1. Apply for vacancies through the recruitment portals of the participating departments
  2. Appear for the selection process as per the notification
  3. Selected candidates receive appointment letters at the Rozgar Mela event

Required Documents

  • As per the recruitment notification of each department
meta_title: Rozgar Mela: Central Government Recruitment Drive
meta_description: Rozgar Mela is a central government recruitment drive distributing appointment letters for departmental vacancies. Learn how selections and melas work.

content:
Overview

The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) is a centrally sponsored welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to vulnerable groups including the elderly, widows, disabled persons, and families below the poverty line. Implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development, NSAP comprises pension schemes such as the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme, widow pension, disability pension, and the National Family Benefit Scheme.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Elderly persons aged 60 years and above living below the poverty line
  • Widows and disabled persons in the age group of 40 to 79 years below the poverty line
  • Families below the poverty line who lose the primary breadwinner

Benefits

  • Monthly pension under the old age, widow, and disability pension components
  • Lump sum assistance of Rs 20,000 to bereaved families under the National Family Benefit Scheme
  • Financial support without requiring contributions from beneficiaries
  • Direct transfer of benefits to bank accounts

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the local panchayat office or the block development office
  2. Submit the application with income and age proof
  3. After verification and approval, the pension is credited monthly to the bank account

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Age proof and BPL identification
  • Death certificate for family benefit claims
meta_title: National Social Assistance Programme: Pensions for the Needy
meta_description: NSAP provides monthly pensions and family assistance to elderly, widows, disabled, and BPL families. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

The Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) is one of the world's largest early childhood development programmes, implemented through anganwadi centres across India. The scheme provides supplementary nutrition, health check-ups, immunisation, and pre-school education to children below six years, along with nutrition and health education for pregnant women and nursing mothers. It is the backbone of India's child nutrition and early education system.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Children in the age group of 0 to 6 years
  • Pregnant women and nursing mothers
  • Adolescent girls in select locations under the scheme's components

Benefits

  • Supplementary nutrition through take home rations and hot cooked meals at anganwadi centres
  • Immunisation and health check-up referrals
  • Pre-school education for children aged 3 to 6 years
  • Growth monitoring, nutrition counselling, and health awareness for mothers

How to Apply

  1. Visit the nearest anganwadi centre in your area
  2. Register the child or the pregnancy with the anganwadi worker
  3. Avail the nutrition, health, and education services on schedule

Required Documents

  • Child's birth certificate or vaccination card
  • Mother's identity proof
meta_title: ICDS: Anganwadi Nutrition & Early Education Services
meta_description: ICDS provides nutrition, immunisation, health check-ups, and pre-school education to children under 6 and mothers through anganwadi centres.

content:
Overview

The Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) is a component of the National Social Assistance Programme that provides monthly pension to persons with severe disabilities living below the poverty line. The scheme gives financial support to disabled persons in the age group of 18 to 79 years, helping them meet basic needs and reduce dependence on others.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Persons with 80 percent or more disability as certified by a medical board
  • Age between 18 and 79 years
  • Belonging to a below poverty line family

Benefits

  • Monthly pension transferred directly to the bank account
  • Financial independence for persons with severe disability
  • Support for medical and daily living expenses

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the local panchayat or block development office
  2. Submit the medical disability certificate and income proof
  3. After verification, receive the monthly pension in the bank account

Required Documents

  • Disability certificate from a recognised medical board
  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Age and income proof
meta_title: IGNDPS: Monthly Pension for Persons with Severe Disability
meta_description: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme provides monthly pension to BPL persons with 80%+ disability aged 18-79. Check eligibility.

content:
Overview

The National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) is a component of the National Social Assistance Programme that provides a lump sum financial assistance of Rs 20,000 to bereaved families below the poverty line. The assistance is given to the family when the primary breadwinner dies, helping the household cope with the sudden loss of income. The scheme is implemented through state governments and district authorities.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Families below the poverty line who lose the primary breadwinner
  • The deceased should have been aged between 18 and 60 years
  • The death should have occurred while the person was the main earner of the family

Benefits

  • Lump sum assistance of Rs 20,000 to the bereaved family
  • Immediate financial relief after the loss of the family's main earner
  • Assistance credited directly to the bank account of the nominee

How to Apply

  1. Submit a claim at the local panchayat or block office with the death certificate
  2. Complete the verification of the family's BPL status and income
  3. Receive the lump sum amount in the bank account of the nominee

Required Documents

  • Death certificate of the breadwinner
  • BPL identification and income proof
  • Aadhaar card and bank account details of the nominee
meta_title: National Family Benefit Scheme: Rs 20,000 to Bereaved Families
meta_description: NFBS provides Rs 20,000 lump sum assistance to BPL families on the death of the primary breadwinner. Check eligibility and how to claim.

content:
Overview

The Annapurna Scheme is a food security programme for senior citizens who are eligible for the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme but are not receiving the pension. Under the scheme, eligible elderly persons receive 10 kilograms of free food grains every month. The scheme ensures that the most vulnerable elderly persons do not go hungry even when they miss out on pension benefits.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens aged 65 years and above
  • Eligible for the old age pension scheme but not receiving the pension
  • Belonging to below poverty line households without any other means of support

Benefits

  • 10 kilograms of free food grains per month per beneficiary
  • Direct distribution through the public distribution system network
  • Nutritional support for destitute senior citizens

How to Apply

  1. Apply at the local panchayat or the ration distribution office
  2. Submit age and income proof along with pension eligibility details
  3. Receive the food grains monthly after the approval of the application

Required Documents

  • Age proof
  • Income certificate or BPL identification
  • Aadhaar card and ration card details
meta_title: Annapurna Scheme: Free Food Grains for Senior Citizens
meta_description: Annapurna Scheme provides 10 kg of free food grains monthly to destitute senior citizens aged 65+. Check eligibility and how to apply.
